results.title: European Parliament Vice President declares hunger strike in support of residents of Oleshky
results.description: European Parliament Vice President Pina Picierno has called for urgent international action, a humanitarian ceasefire and safe civilian evacuations from Oleshky.

results.title: Air defenses intercept 150 drones used by Russia to attack Ukraine overnight
results.description: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 150 out of the 186 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of October 20.
